# Batches B005 (check-architecture.js), B007 (check-manifests.js), B008 (lib/common.js)

@@ output/template/.claude/scripts/check-architecture.js ;; Executable architecture checker (CLI exit 0/1/2; called by post-tool-use hook).
@scope executable: check-architecture.js (hooks after edits/commands; manual/verify runs)
1-10 IM ;; Header: purpose, data sources (selected frame/persistence manifests), usage.
12-17 IM ;; Imports and finding helper.
19-42 IM ;; Loads the selected frame specification and resolves namespace placeholders; throws (cannot run) when no frame/spec is selected.
44-53 IM ;; Classifies projects by test/layer suffix or test-framework package.
55-64 IM ;; Reads ProjectReference names and unreadable elements.
66-74 IM ;; Collects backend projects.
75-79 MX [arc020.unknown-project,x.project-suffix-naming] ;; A project matching no frame layer/test role warns that adding a project or layer is Reserved (ARC-020); the warning also enforces the layer-suffix naming convention (added).
80-83 IM ;; Unreadable reference elements reported as incomplete-check warnings.
84-90 OL [arc001.no-test-refs] ;; ;; references test project
91-94 IM ;; References to projects matching no frame layer are warnings (unclassifiable).
95-98 OL [arc001.layer-matrix] ;; ;; dependencies point inward
99-101 OL [arc028.test-matrix] ;; ;; keep test references as narrow as the test scope requires
102-105 IM ;; Loop closings.
107-114 IM ;; Maps a file to its owning project.
116-135 OL [arc008.forbidden-namespaces] ;; ;; types must not be used in this layer
137-146 IM ;; checkArchitecture aggregation and export.
148-164 IM ;; CLI entry: exit 1 on errors, 2 when it cannot run.

C arc020.unknown-project OL ARC-020,ARC-027 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; A backend project matching no frame layer or test-project role raises a warning that adding a project or layer is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.project-suffix-naming EX DEP-024,ARC-001 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Backend projects are expected to end with the frame suffixes (.Domain, .Application, .Infrastructure, .Api, .Domain.Tests, .Application.Tests, .Infrastructure.Tests, .IntegrationTests); others are flagged. ;; = ;; none ;; Project naming convention not in the oracle.
C arc001.no-test-refs OL ARC-001,ARC-028 ENFORCED ;; A production project referencing a test project is an error. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/scripts/check-manifests.js ;; Executable dependency-manifest checker (CLI exit 0/1/2; called by post-tool-use and stop hooks).

C x.deny-polly-integration EX DEP-020,DEP-004 ENFORCED ;; Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly and Polly.Extensions.Http are errors (deprecated resilience integrations). ;; = ;; none ;; Hard executable ban stricter than DEP-020's default/exception wording.
C x.deny-es-sink EX DEP-004,DEP-021 ENFORCED ;; Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch is an error (deprecated sink; use Elastic.Serilog.Sinks). ;; = ;; none ;; Package-specific ban not in the oracle.
C x.deny-fv-aspnetcore EX DEP-010 ENFORCED ;; FluentValidation.AspNetCore is an error (legacy automatic-validation integration). ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle names FluentValidation as standard but does not ban this integration package.
C dep020.polly-warn OL DEP-020 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Direct Polly references are flagged (WARN) as an explicit documented exception. ;; = ;; Documented exception. ;;
C dep006.version-in-project OL DEP-006 ENFORCED ;; A PackageReference declaring a version in a project file is an error. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.versionoverride-documented EX DEP-006 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; VersionOverride is flagged as needing a concrete, documented reason. ;; = ;; none ;; Documentation obligation beyond DEP-006.
C dep006.cpm-enabled-check OL DEP-006 ENFORCED ;; Directory.Packages.props without ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true is an error. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.version-checks OL DEP-003 ENFORCED ;; Prerelease versions warn as allowed only when explicitly requested; floating versions are errors. ;; = ;; Prerelease on explicit request. ;;
C x.floating-no-exception EX DEP-003 ENFORCED ;; Floating or empty versions ('*', empty; npm '', '*', 'latest', x) are errors with no explicit-request exception (range specifiers such as ^/~/[..] are not flagged). ;; = ;; none ;; DEP-003 allows floating versions when explicitly requested.
C dep007.lockfile OL DEP-007 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; A package.json with dependencies but no package-lock.json warns to maintain and commit the lockfile. ;; = ;; none ;;
